mechanism: Amphetamine increases heart rate and blood pressure while febuxostat carries inherent cardiovascular risk, creating additive cardiac stress; additionally, both drugs may compete for hepatic metabolism via CYP1A2 and CYP2C9.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and cardiac symptoms closely; consider alternative urate-lowering therapy or amphetamine if interaction risk is unacceptable; educate patient on warning signs of cardiac complications.
